title: Mary and Martha
reflectionQuestion: Mary loved to sit close and simply be with Jesus. When do you feel happiest just being near someone you love?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (extra, emotional room = BEING WITH > BEING BUSY; the quiet register the lane lacked). Per Adam: do NOT make Martha the villain -- she loves Jesus too, she's just frazzled/distracted; Jesus gently invites her, warm to BOTH sisters (the close explicitly says both were dearly loved). For an overwhelmed/overstimulated child: routes to slowing down + being close. NO long (full-only): a single quiet scene with one gentle turn; a long would pad and dull its stillness (same call as Abraham's stars / David's harp). mood calm_peaceful. 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_MARY_PONDER (contemplative -- fits being-with-Jesus). Female-led.
